Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'text/plain', uri: 'https://example.com/text/report.txt'), { 'captioning' => { 'llm' => { 'max_concurrency' => 2, 'model' => 'openai/gpt-4o' }, 'min_image_area' => 1000 }, 'concurrency' => { 'max_threads' => 8 } })
puts result.results[0].mime_type.inspect
puts result.results[0].content.inspect
```
